第一帧画面里，右侧一名赤裸上身、仅下身围着粗糙草编腰布的老年黑人男子呈蹲姿，他皮肤布满汗珠，正神情专注地伸出双手，小心调整前方一个表面高度抛光、能够清晰反射出他身形的纯金金字塔锥尖（即古埃及金字塔传统结构里的顶尖石）；这个金锥尖的底座四角分别固定着粗麻绳，斜向延伸固定在周围的石面锚点上，平台中后部的石砌环形结构留有方形开口，远处平台边缘还能看到两名正在劳作的古埃及施工者的模糊身影。
第二帧画面中，原本位于金锥尖右侧的男子全身消失，仅留他的一双手从画面左右两侧的边缘伸入镜头，两侧手掌悬在金锥尖的旁侧同步发力，配合着牵拉连接金锥尖的麻绳，金锥尖被微微抬升，底部离开原本的石面落点，移动到平台的方形开口正上方。
第三帧画面里，男子的双手完全退出画面，金锥尖重新平稳放置回开口前方的原始石制落点上，所有麻绳重新绷直固定，平台上没有任何人物留存，金锥尖在阳光下反射出明亮的暖金色光泽，整个顶层平台场景回归安静，完成了古金字塔金锥尖吊装归位的收尾动作。","render_task_id":"7680579987224723482","cover_url":"https://p11-sign.douyinpic.com/everphoto-jianying-assets/ogTBWtSfbl8va5DIZoWBu8HDgC7gAWbIhqcAEf~tplv-noop.image?dy_q=1788274436&l=20260901224121BF38EFE90085DFDB0DA1&x-expires=1803826453&x-signature=nQTfjEIOdntdu55tTdArL6zEEYw%3D","music_meta":null,"preview_url":"https://v5-xyq-video.jianying.com/906d23ca28374b01894480efe01759eb/6b843515/video/n/everphoto-jianying-assets/6657e70850184dcca1329389b2519238/?a=795647&ch=0&cr=0&dr=0&cd=0%7C0%7C0%7C0&br=6250&bt=6250&cs=0&ds=3&ft=TLtriUeR_yygZmo0PCQo9gkVQ9w6x&mime_type=video_mp4&qs=13&rc=amozNTRvOnloZDczNDlmM0BpamozNTRvOnloZDczNDlmM0BzZmxzYWFuYV9hLS1kNC9zYSNzZmxzYWFuYV9hLS1kNC9zcw%3D%3D&btag=80000e00010000&dy_q=1788274436&l=20260901224121BF38EFE90085DFDB0DA1","render_task_status":null,"draft_key":null,"package_id":null,"vid":null,"render_rsp_map":{"disable_edit":"0"},"download_url":"https://v11-xyq-video.jianying.com/d0de4fb2594fef81f7a85c2b6e3d6500/6b843515/video/n/everphoto-jianying-assets/d79318e6a0214a0c8b6899d024252cb7/?a=795647&ch=0&cr=0&dr=0&cd=0%7C0%7C0%7C0&br=4607&bt=4607&cs=0&ds=3&ft=TLtriUeR_yygZmo0PCQo9gkVQ9w6x&mime_type=video_mp4&qs=13&rc=M3dydmRvOjNoZDczNDlmM0BpM3dydmRvOjNoZDczNDlmM0BnaWZwYWEvYl9hLS1kNC9zYSNnaWZwYWEvYl9hLS1kNC9zcw%3D%3D&btag=80000e00010000&dy_q=1788274436&l=20260901224121BF38EFE90085DFDB0DA1&download=true&filename=v02c76g10004dabee027dldassioltj0.mp4","ratio":null,"title":"","duration":0,"width":0,"height":0,"cover_preview_url":null,"cover_preview_key":null,"player_info":null,"preview_url_v2":null,"unique_id":null,"scene_segment":null,"pippit_asset_id":null,"extra":null},"gif_url":null,"living_photo_url":null,"task_id":null,"error_message":null,"error_code":null}
